acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, OmShare is completely free. There are no subscription fees, hidden costs, or premium tiers.

mainEntity.name: What is the file size limit?

acceptedAnswer.text: OmShare has no file size limits. You can transfer files from kilobytes to gigabytes depending on your browser memory and internet connection.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to create an account?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, OmShare requires no sign-up or account creation. Just select a file and get a code.
Yes, files transfer directly between browsers using encrypted connections. We never store file content on servers.

mainEntity.name: How long does a transfer code last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each 6-digit code expires after 24 hours. If no one connects within 24 hours, the code becomes invalid.
